Thanks for the ping. Quick checklist and constraints from Security/Compliance: 

- Acceptable notarization: a scanned PDF of the original notarized signature page is sufficient for AWS marketplace as long as the notarization is visible and the document shows notarization details (notary name, state, commission expiration). We don't need the physical original.
- Redaction: strip any customer-identifying data from the pen‑test report (IPs, customer domain names). Keep pen‑test executive summary and attestation letter intact.
- SOC2: we'll produce a one‑page control summary (no report PDFs) for marketplace consumption. If AWS requests the full report, Procurement/legal will route a secure transfer.
- Canonical filenames and manifest: please attach a manifest CSV listing file hashes and redaction decisions. This helps downstream auditors.

I'll prep the SOC2 one‑pager and the redaction_instructions.pdf for Nebula. Rishi — can you create the S3 staging prefix and set a 7‑day presigned policy? Prefer s3://redwood-evidence-staging/nebula/<deal>/ and we can timestamp it.

Estimated ETA: SOC2 one‑pager + redaction instructions by Thu EOD, DocuSign envelope should be ready by Thu evening from Priya.

Kim
Sr. Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction_instructions.pdf (PDF), evidence_manifest_template.csv (CSV)
